title: National Immunization Schedule (NIS) — India
purpose: Reference dataset for JeevanSetu AI. Use for general vaccination education only; vaccination decisions should be confirmed with an authorised healthcare professional or government health facility.

primary_source.name: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India — National Immunization Schedule

official_nhm_source.name: National Health Mission — National Immunization Schedule

notes: Japanese Encephalitis (JE) vaccination is applicable in selected endemic areas/districts as specified by the programme.
Some vaccine schedules may have programme-specific eligibility or regional applicability.
The chatbot should not tell a user to skip, repeat, or change a vaccine dose based only on chatbot advice.
For a missed dose, the chatbot should recommend contacting the nearest government health facility or vaccination provider rather than inventing a catch-up schedule.

critical_notes: This schedule is for general health education and RAG retrieval, not individualized medical advice.
Japanese Encephalitis vaccination applies in selected endemic areas/districts according to the government programme.
For missed or delayed doses, direct the user to an authorised vaccination provider rather than inventing a catch-up schedule.
The chatbot must not tell a user to skip, repeat, delay, or change a vaccine dose based only on AI output.
response_restrictions: Do not create a personalized catch-up schedule.
Do not advise skipping, repeating, delaying, or changing a vaccine dose.
For missed doses or adverse reactions, recommend contacting an authorised vaccination provider.
For JE, confirm programme/location applicability before presenting it as routinely applicable.
